text: dsh-preview-media 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的媒体预览插件，在右侧文档预览中为视频和音频文件注册播放器。它通过 Host 流式路由按 HTTP Range 读取文件，并由客户端使用浏览器原生播放器展示。视频可使用播放速度、循环、全屏和画中画控件，音频也可调速和循环；桌面端提供回环来源以支持媒体定位。适合需要在 DSH 文件预览中直接查看影音内容的用户。无需额外账号或 API 密钥。

dsh-preview-media adds video and audio preview to the DSH Web sidebar. It streams files with HTTP Range and native browser controls. Video supports speed, loop, fullscreen, and picture-in-picture; audio supports speed and loop. Desktop seeking can use a loopback origin.
想在 DSH 右侧文件预览里直接播放视频和音频。
DSH 打开 mp4 或 mp3 时只显示不支持格式，怎么加播放器？
I want to seek through a large video while previewing it in DSH.
dsh-preview-media 的功能「影音侧栏预览」：在 DSH 文档预览中为配置的音视频后缀注册播放器，分别用原生 video 和 audio 控件呈现媒体文件。
dsh-preview-media 的功能「分段媒体播放」：Host 路由按 HTTP Range 请求分段读取文件并返回媒体数据，播放器可按需加载内容和定位播放进度。
dsh-preview-media 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 19 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-preview-media README · dsh-preview-media：Video and audio preview for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): play `mp4`, `mov`, `mkv`, `webm` and `mp3`, `flac`, `wav` right inside the right-Sidebar document preview instead of the built-in “this format cannot be previewed” empty state.

dsh-preview-media README · Why：The built-in preview registers renderers for text, code, Markdown, images, PDF, HTML, Office and spreadsheets, and lists video/audio suffixes as *known binary containers with no renderer* — so opening a video shows an icon and one line of text. This plugin registers those suffixes and draws the browser's native player, fed by an authenticated streaming route that honours HTTP `Range`, so seeking works and a 2 GB file is never loaded into memory or into the conversation.

dsh-preview-media README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-preview-media
```

Then restart the desktop app (a profile patch change is read at boot). No configuration is required; the defaults cover the common suffixes.

To check it loaded, open any `.mp4` from the Files tab: the preview pane shows the player rather than the unsupported-format notice.

dsh-preview-media README · What it does：- **Renderer** — registers two document-previews implementations, `dsh-preview-media/video` (video suffixes) and `dsh-preview-media/audio` (audio suffixes), with priority `extension`, `loading: 'renderer'`, and their suffixes declared binary so the “plain text” fallback is not offered.
- **Player** — a native `<video>`/`<audio>` element with the browser's own controls. The video is fitted into the pane with `object-fit: contain` inside a flexible frame, so a portrait or landscape clip is fully visible at once, with black letterboxing instead of spilling past the preview edge. Below it sit **倍速 / Speed** (cycles 1× → 1.25× → 1.5× → 1.75× → 2× → 0.5× → 0.75×), **循环 / Loop**, and — for video — **全屏 / Full screen** and **画中画 / Picture in picture**. Speed and loop also apply to audio, and the choice is remembered per browser. Audio shows a card with the file name, its size and the player. The body reports `loaded` / `failed` back to the document preview owner so the tab's loading state settles.
- **Stream** — a Host route `GET|HEAD /api/preview/media?path=<absolute path>` that answers `200` with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `206` with `Content-Range` f
dsh-preview-media README · Configuration：Settings live on the `preview-media` entry (Settings → Plugins, or the profile patch). Every key has a code-side default, so a partial config is valid.

dsh-preview-media README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Mount the route at all. _Off_ leaves the renderer registered but transfers no bytes (`503`). |
| `routePath` | `/api/preview/media` | Route pathname. Must start with `/api/`; anything else falls back to the default so the auth fence still applies. |
| `loopback` | `true` | Also serve bytes from the token-guarded `127.0.0.1` origin. This is what makes the desktop player seekable. _Off_ keeps only the authenticated route: the desktop shell can play but not seek. |
| `debug` | `false` | Append playback/loopback diagnostics to `$DSH_HOME/preview-media-debug.log`. Leave off unless you are diagnosing a problem. |
| `maxBytes` | `2147483648` (2 GiB) | Largest file served; larger files answer `413`. |
| `chunkBytes` | `1048576` | Bytes per ranged read. |
| `videoExtensions` | `mp4, m4v, mov, webm, ogv, ogg, mkv, avi, wmv, flv, 3gp, ts, m2ts, mts` | Suffixes the video player claims. |
| `audioExtensions` | `mp3, wav, flac, m4a, aac, oga, opus, weba, wma, aiff, aif` | Suffixes the audio player claims. |

dsh-preview-media README · Configuration：The browser half mirrors the suffix lists in `lib/client.js`; keep them in sync when changing either side. The route path is published to the page as `__DSH_PREVIEW_MEDIA_CONFIG__` by the Host, so a configured path and the player's URL never drift apart.

dsh-preview-media README · Playback support：Playback depends on the browser's own codecs, not on this plugin. Chromium/Electron plays MP4 (H.264/AAC), WebM (VP8/VP9/Opus), Ogg and most audio formats. **Matroska (`.mkv`) and AVI usually do not decode** in Chromium; the player then reports “浏览器不支持这个编码 / This codec is not supported by the browser” and the _Open in app_ control in the preview header still hands the file to the system player. Remuxing such files to MP4/WebM is the reliable fix.

dsh-preview-media README · How it is built：```
lib/index.js    Host entry: name / inject / Config / apply (route, loopback origin, index injection)
lib/config.js   Defaults and normalization, no host imports (unit-testable)
lib/schema.js   schemastery Config for the loader/settings page
lib/range.js    HTTP Range interpretation, pure functions

dsh-preview-media README · How it is built：The browser half is a hand-written module-loader bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) with `react` and `react/jsx-runtime` as its only module-table requests, so it needs no build step and cannot drift from the Host's React copy.

dsh-preview-media README · Development：```sh
node --test test/*.test.js
```

For end-to-end checks, start a host with the plugin installed and run the probe:

```sh
node scripts/e2e-browser.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token> --video "<absolute path to a video>"
```

`E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge` makes Playwright use the system Edge when the bundled Chromium is unavailable.

Seeking has its own check, including the desktop transport shape:

dsh-preview-media README · Development：```sh
node scripts/e2e-seek.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token <token> --video "<absolute path to a video>" --simulate-desktop
```

dsh-preview-media README · Known limitations：- One byte window per request; a multi-range `Range` header is answered `416`. Browsers only ever ask a media element for one window.
- `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.wmv`, `.flv` are claimed and listed, but Chromium cannot decode them; the plugin shows the player's error state rather than pretending they play.
- No playlist, subtitle-track or speed controls of its own — the native controls own those.
- If a deployment blocks the loopback origin (firewall, policy), the player falls back to the authenticated route automatically: the file still plays, but the desktop timeline is not seekable again. That is an Electron limitation ([electron#38749](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/38749), [electron#51442](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/51442)), not something the route can fix.
